description: This file defines the InternalGraphicsState class within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, managing the internal state of a graphics context such as transform matrices and clipping paths, especially for PDF rendering contexts. It includes methods for handling the graphics state stack, including push and pop operations, with conditional compilation for GDI and WPF.

classes.name: InternalGraphicsState
classes.description: Represents the internal graphics state for XGraphics objects, managing transformation matrices and clip regions, with methods for stack management and conditional compilation for platform-specific graphics context handling.

methods.name: Pushed
methods.description: Called after this graphics state instance is pushed onto the internal stack; currently does nothing in GDI but may handle specific tasks in WPF.

methods.name: Popped
methods.description: Called after this graphics state instance is popped from the stack; marks the state as invalid and performs platform-specific cleanup, such as popping transformations or clip regions.
